name: pin-key
assumes: A pin connected to a net, read by the KiCad netlist parser (a (node ...) of a kicadsexpr export) or the Altium document parser (a pin record on a sheet)
number: KiCad (pin ...), Altium Designator; empty when absent or ""
name: KiCad (pinfunction ...) less its trailing _<number>, with "~" meaning unnamed; Altium Name
refdes: KiCad (ref ...), Altium the owning component's designator
The key is the PIN in REFDES.PIN: the pin's entry in the component's pins and in each net it is on
Altium names a pin-named net Net<refdes>_<key> from the same key

shares: whether another pin of the same part with the same key was listed before this one: on this net, on an earlier net with other pins, or on an earlier lone net. A lone net is KiCad's unconnected-(...) stub for an open pin, a net of one node; Altium leaves a net of one pin and nothing else out
Not covered: a one-pin net that carries a label. KiCad counts it lone, so it yields a shared name key to a net with other pins; Altium keeps it, and a shared key goes to the net it traces first
